notes: *shall it not be* divides three ways: the fronted auxiliary to הֲ (rule 17), the negative to לוֹא, and the dummy subject with the copula to the prepositional predicate (rules 49, 20).
No preposition heads קַחְתִּי, so the construct relation itself licenses *when*, which goes on the infinitive as nomen rectum — rule 52's last clause and its עֵת הִדְרִיכָהּ example.
The suffix of מַשָּׂא is realized twice, as *they* and *their*, and heads on the direct pronoun under rule 18.
